newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico sees 1997 exports over $100 billion.
newsitem.headline: Mexico sees 1997 exports over $100 billion.

text.p: Mexican deputy finance minister Martin Werner said Tuesday that total exports of goods and services from Mexico in 1997 would exceed $100 billion.
"For 1997 we are forecasting that total exports of goods and services from Mexico will be more than $100 billion," Werner said.

Speaking at a global emerging markets conference organized by the International Federation of Stock Exchanges (FIB), Werner also said that in the first three months of this year about 200,000 jobs had been created in the formal sector of the economy.
He added that in the whole of 1996 some 800,000 jobs were created in the formal sector in Mexico as the country recovered from its devastating 1995 recession.
